description.value: Roy Stewart Morrison Nature Park is a nature reserve near Courtenay on Vancouver Island, documented by BC Nature, the provincial federation of naturalist clubs. The park is situated on Vancouver Island's east coast and would appeal to touring cyclists seeking a natural area to explore. No further details about the park's size, trails, or history were recoverable from the available sources.
